calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art modular game source for The Last Lantern, Level 10 Mother Tree sanctuary.
Primary request: a single ancient Mother Tree with massive dark brown trunk, readable hollow central core and broad layered blue-green canopy, roots spreading into a quiet forest clearing. Top-down three-quarter pixel art, square pixels, restrained detail, midnight teal palette, soft warm hints in bark. Wide landscape composition, large tree at upper center, open dark ground in lower half for separately composited puzzle modules. Keep trunk/core and canopy clearly separable by silhouette. No crystals, no light beams, no puzzle symbols, no lantern, no people, no text, no UI, no sun, no bloom. Atmospheric but readable at 640x360. The clearing is spacious and safe; tree roots do not draw a solved puzzle. Production source art, no borders or contact-sheet panels.
